public_task_spec.scientific_context: TrpB synthesizes tryptophan from indole and serine. The public benchmark contains growth-based fitness measurements over ten combinatorial sub-landscapes spanning 20 engineered positions.
public_task_spec.source_partition: Official train and validation variants with zero or one mutation.
public_task_spec.deployment_partition: Official test variants with more than one mutation.
public_task_spec.optimization_endpoint: Best-so-far growth-fitness AUC under three initial target observations and twelve additional reveals.
public_task_spec.evidence_constraint: Official test fitness values are unavailable to the planner, calibration gate, skill selector, candidate sampler, and protocol author at freeze time.
public_task_spec.finite_pool_rule: Within each official partition, retain at most 5,000 sequences with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 sequence hashes. The rule uses sequence only and is frozen before download.
public_task_spec.candidate_skill: A bounded additive mutation prior learned only from completed low-order source outcomes and blended with target-only GP-UCB using fixed decaying authority.
public_task_spec.primary_mechanism_null: The true source sequence-outcome assignment is no better than deterministic permutations of the same source outcomes across the same source sequences.
public_task_spec.source: Didi et al., FLIP2, ICML 2026 Spotlight; official FLIP2 website and download asset.

failure_conditions: Epistasis dominates such that higher-order target variants are not well-approximated by sums of single-mutation effects, making the additive prior systematically biased.

The primary_mechanism_null cannot be rejected: the true source sequence-outcome assignment performs no better than deterministic permutations of the same outcomes, indicating the additive signal is not real.
Source single-mutation coverage is incomplete for the mutations composing target variants, so summed effects rely on missing or imputed terms.
The fixed decaying authority is miscalibrated relative to true source-target correlation, causing the source rank to mislead early GP-UCB reveals under the tight 3+12 budget.
Distribution shift between zero/one-mutation source landscape and multi-mutation target partition (e.g., different position interactions) breaks transfer.
parsed_hypothesis.hypothesis: Shrunk per-mutation additive effects estimated from completed low-order source variants (0-1 mutations) provide a rank-informative prior for higher-order target variants (>1 mutation), such that blending this source rank with target-only GP-UCB under a fixed decaying authority improves best-so-far growth-fitness AUC over target-only GP-UCB within the 3+12 reveal budget.
parsed_hypothesis.mechanism: TrpB fitness over the engineered positions carries a substantial additive (first-order) component. Single-mutation source effects are estimated with shrinkage toward zero to control variance, then summed across the mutations defining each target variant to produce a first-order fitness surrogate. This surrogate yields a ranking of finite-pool target candidates. The ranking is blended with target-only GP-UCB acquisition under a fixed, monotonically decaying authority weight so the source prior guides early reveals (when target data are sparse) and its influence fades as target observations accumulate, at which point GP-UCB dominates.
parsed_hypothesis.rationale: The one-to-many official split explicitly maps low-order source measurements to higher-order target variants, matching the additive-transfer structure. Additivity is the leading-order expectation in mutational-scanning landscapes, so a shrunk additive prior is a scientifically motivated first-order approximation rather than an invented signal. Under a very small target budget (3 initial + 12 reveals), any unbiased prior that improves early ranking is disproportionately valuable, and the fixed decaying authority bounds downside risk by guaranteeing the source influence vanishes as target evidence grows. Because no target or test fitness values are available, this decision rests solely on split structure, landscape metadata, and the additivity prior; it does not depend on observed performance. The recommendation is conditional on passing the calibration gate that rejects the primary_mechanism_null on source data alone.
parsed_hypothesis.transfer_scope: Transfer only shrunk first-order per-mutation effects from completed source (0-1 mutation) train/validation variants to the finite-pool (<=5000 lexicographically smallest SHA-256 hashes) target partition of multi-mutation official test variants, blended via fixed decaying authority with target-only GP-UCB; no higher-order interaction terms are transferred and no target/test fitness values are used at freeze time.
